docstring:
In particular, there should be infinitely many $n$, but the set of such $n$ should have
density zero. Unfortunately this heuristic is difficult to turn into a proof.
references: [ErGr80, p.34] Erdős, P. and Graham, R., Old and new problems and results in combinatorial number theory. Monographies de L'Enseignement Mathematique (1980).
[Sh16] P. Shiu, The denominators of harmonic numbers. arXiv:1607.02863 (2016).
[WuYa22] Wu, Bing-Ling and Yan, Xiao-Hui, On the denominators of harmonic numbers. {IV}. C. R. Math. Acad. Sci. Paris (2022), 53--57.
type_pretty: Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ↑{n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N | (Erdos291.a n).gcd (Erdos291.L n) = 1}.card / ↑N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
